BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to highway emergency projects; and adding a newsection to chapter 47.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If a project qualifies as an emergency project under subsection(2) of this section, the department shall, as soon as practicable, takeall necessary steps to complete environmental reviews, engineering, anddesign to ensure prompt construction of the project. (2) An emergency project is any project that meets all of thefollowing conditions: (a) The project is planned for a highway of statewide significance; (b) The project is on a route that has been declared a safetycorridor by the governor or the department; (c) The project was first proposed by a state or local agency atleast forty years before the date of the declaration made under (b) ofthis subsection; (d) A feasibility study was completed on the project at least forty p. 1 SB 6188years before the date of the declaration made under (b) of thissubsection; (e) The department has acquired a substantial portion of the rightofway necessary for completion of the project; (f) The purpose of the project is not served through the completionof a different project; and (g) The need for the project has not been substantially diminished.
